pa.s: overall quality of the survey is ok. But some lines were contaminated with some seismic swell noise. The denoise workflow (TFDN ) in shot domain removed quite lot of noise, but there were still some noise left in the deep part. Suppression of multiples with SRME has proven to be adequate. Later in processing dipping noise has successfully removed in TAUP dom
